newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle market not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle market not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow, with not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for an adequate market test, USDA said. Inquiry and demand light.
Sales confirmed on 200 slaughter steers and 200 slaughter heifers Friday. This week's confirmed sales 80,800 head including 16,800 head or about 21 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1300 lbs 71.00.
Slaughter heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1180 lbs 71.00.
Confirmed - 400 last week - none last year - 1,900
